item.title: Grease the Musical — Thu Aug 13, 7:30 PM — Woodland Opera House
item.description: Leather jackets and poodle skirts are taking over the Woodland Opera House stage this August as The Woodland Wellness Collective presents Grease. Set in 1959 at Rydell High, Grease follows the duck-tailed, hot-rodding Burger Palace Boys and the gum-snapping Pink Ladies as they navigate friendship, first love, peer pressure, and growing up. After a whirlwind summer romance, Danny Zuko and Sandy Dumbrowski unexpectedly reunite at school, where Danny must choose between his tough-guy image and his true feelings. Packed with unforgettable characters, energetic dance numbers, and a rock ‘n’ roll score that has captivated audiences for decades, Grease remains a timeless celebration of youth and self-discovery. item.description: Yolo County Fair August 7th-9th & August 12th-16th The Yolo County Fair, California’s longest-running free-gate fair, returns in 2026 with more days, more entertainment and more opportunities for families to celebrate the region’s agricultural heritage. For the first time in its history, the Fair will span eight days over two weekends. An Outdoor Kickoff Weekend will run Friday, Aug. 7 through Sunday, Aug. 9, followed by the traditional Fair Wednesday, Aug. 12 through Sunday, Aug. 16. Admission to the Fair, themed “Hog August Nights this year,” remains free. The new opening weekend will feature headline arena concerts by country music stars Hunter Hayes and Chris Lane, corgi racing, livestock shows, a carnival midway, silent discos and live entertainment on multiple stages. item.description:
The beloved Picnic in the Park season is back at the Davis Farmers Market starting Wednesday, April 1, 2026! Every Wednesday evening through August 26, the market expands to 4:00 – 8:00 PM, turning Central Park into the perfect spot for a relaxed picnic dinner. Shop fresh produce, artisan goods, and a wide variety of prepared foods from your favorite vendors. Enjoy local craft beer, wine, and brand new this year – mead! Each week features live music and children’s activities, creating a festive, family-friendly atmosphere. Bring blankets, lawn chairs, and reusable bags. It’s the ideal way to unwind, connect with neighbors, and support local farmers and food makers. This year is extra special as the Davis Farmers Market celebrates its 50th Anniversary! item.title: Weekly Game Night at Blue Note — Wed Oct 28, 5:00 PM
item.description:
Yolo County Board Game Gathering Update 8/14/25: **We're still active**, but we primarily use Discord to chat and plan events. (See group description for invite link.)
We still meet every Wednesday for board games at Blue Note Brewing Company. We'll have a handful of tables reserved near the back; just look for the pile of board games.
People usually start arriving around 5pm, and games start whenever people are ready. Blue Note closes at 9pm, and although we have a 5-10 minute grace period there, you should be in the process of final scoring by 9, or else pack it up and play again another day.
Game night is open to all ages! Blue Note is a brewery, not a bar, so there's no restriction against minors. In addition to their crafted-in-house beer selection, water and sodas are available.
You're not required to buy anything in order to join us, but we do encourage you to support local businesses. Blue Note's chef team makes a mean pizza, and there are other nearby downtown restaurants

item.title: Hope Café: Finding Connection — Thu Aug 20, 6:30 PM — International House Davis
item.description:
Join us on two nights, August 20th and September 25th, to celebrate the start of fall with an evening at the International House Davis, designed to build connection and community. Hope Café is a mix of a workshop and a party, opening up a space where live music, creative activities, and guided conversations invite you to reflect and develop a new connection.
Activities include: community story sharing and playful creative exercises until 8:30 PM, live world jazz by Nick Carvajal and Jim Frink, and complimentary food and drinks provided by the Davis Food Co-Op.
Tickets operate on a sliding scale of $15 – $25. Free tickets are available upon request by emailing office@internationalhousedavis.org. This event is open to community members ages 14 and older.
To purchase tickets, visit: https://secure.internationalhousedavis.org/nx/portal/neonevents/events?path=%2Fportal%2Fevents%2F49102
Source: Hate-Free Together

item.title: Peace Picnic — Sat Sep 26, 11:00 AM — Fern Park
item.description:
The Woodland Ecumenical and Multi-faith Ministries (WEMM), an interfaith council consisting of faith communities, is hosting the annual Peace Picnic. The “Community Interfaith Peace Picnic” in Woodland, is an event that involves bringing together people from various religious backgrounds to promote peace, understanding, and collaboration. The picnic features meaningful conversations, games, and several speakers.
The event will occur on September 26th, at 11:00 AM. Complimentary Pakistani food will be served. Drinks will also be included.
The event is free for all. All ages are welcome.
For more information, visit: https://woodlandwemm.org/
Source: Hate-Free Together

item.title: Day in Downtown — Sun Sep 27, 3:00 AM
item.description:
Spend a full day exploring Day in Downtown – a vibrant, free street event bringing together local talent and community! From 10 AM to 4 PM, browse a diverse lineup of vendors on E Street (between 3rd & 4th St.), including:
Vintage clothing & unique finds Local artists, makers, and creators Davis brick-and-mortar shops Non-profits sharing their work Music by DRC Special spots like Sophia’s Thai Kitchen for tasty bites
Discover one-of-a-kind items, support small businesses and local organizations, and enjoy the lively energy of downtown Davis. Perfect for a relaxed Sunday outing with friends, family, or solo shopping. Bring reusable bags and comfy shoes!
Source: Davis Downtown

item.title: Davis Neighbors' Night Out — Sun Oct 4
item.description:
Join the City of Davis, Yolo County, ASUCD, and UC Davis in celebrating community during Davis Neighbors’ Night Out. Davis Neighbors’ Night Out is a celebration of our community and a great opportunity for neighbors to get to know one another. Connected neighborhoods create safer and more caring places to live
Events include potlucks, neighborhood games and activities and gatherings of neighbors to meet in the street for good conversation.
Davis Neighbors’ Night Out is open to all ages and is free to participate in.
Neighbors, neighborhood associations, apartment complexes, etc., are encouraged to be an “Event Sponsor.” If you’re interested in becoming an event sponsor, visit: https://www.cityofdavis.org/city-hall/city-manager-s-office/community-events/davis-neighbors-night-out

item.title: Davis City Council Meetings — Thu Nov 5, 6:30 PM — City Hall Community Chambers
item.description:
The Davis City Council provides policy direction, establishes goals, and sets priorities for City government. City Council holds regular meetings beginning at 6:30 p.m. on Tuesdays. Most commonly, meetings are held on the first and third Tuesdays of the month, with additional meetings scheduled as needed. The City Council meeting schedule is subject to change.
The Davis City Council meets in the Community Chambers at City Hall, 23 Russell Boulevard. All regular meeting materials are posted at least 72 hours in advance and special meeting materials at least 24 hours in advance.
Visit the City Council site for information on agenda, special meetings, and more.
Source: Hate-Free Together

item.title: DJUSD Board Meetings — Thu Nov 5, 6:30 PM — City Hall Community Chambers
item.description:
DJUSD Board meetings offer insight on how the school district remains responsive to the community’s values, beliefs, and priorities. The Board meetings occur on every first and third Thursday, in the City of Davis Community Chambers. 23 Russell Boulevard. Public session starts at 6:30 PM. Meetings are cablecast live on Channel 17 (Comcast) or streamed on the DJUSD-TV website.
The Davis Joint Unified School District’s Board of Education is comprised of five community members, responsible for setting district policy, approving the budget, and hiring the superintendent for schools in Davis, California. The agendas for the meetings are posted at least 72 hours in advance.
For more information on special meetings, agendas, public comment, and more, visit the DJUSD Board site.
Source: Hate-Free Together

item.title: Weekly Game Night at Blue Note — Wed Aug 26, 5:00 PM
item.description:
Yolo County Board Game Gathering Update 8/14/25: **We're still active**, but we primarily use Discord to chat and plan events. (See group description for invite link.)
We still meet every Wednesday for board games at Blue Note Brewing Company. We'll have a handful of tables reserved near the back; just look for the pile of board games.
People usually start arriving around 5pm, and games start whenever people are ready. Blue Note closes at 9pm, and although we have a 5-10 minute grace period there, you should be in the process of final scoring by 9, or else pack it up and play again another day.
Game night is open to all ages! Blue Note is a brewery, not a bar, so there's no restriction against minors. In addition to their crafted-in-house beer selection, water and sodas are available.
You're not required to buy anything in order to join us, but we do encourage you to support local businesses. Blue Note's chef team makes a mean pizza, and there are other nearby downtown restaurants
